AdR-Gaussian is a rendering acceleration method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that optimizes the rasterization pipeline by moving serial culling operations to a parallel preprocessing stage and balancing computational loads across pixel threads [S1].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that AdR-Gaussian is a rendering acceleration method for 3D Gaussian Splatting. It confirms that the method optimizes the rasterization pipeline by moving serial culling operations from the Render stage to the parallel Preprocess stage (early culling). Furthermore, it details the introduction of a load balancing method to minimize thread waiting time by balancing computational loads across pixel threads. All specific facts mentioned in the claim are present in the provided notes and passages.
